title: Widen further: ASPECT_RATIO 96->128
description: Deviated from the crowded (6-way duplicate) batch+width stack proposal; instead tested whether continuing to widen (ASPECT_RATIO 96->128, n_embd 768->1024) helps further, since 64->96 was a win. Had to drop DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 128->64 to avoid OOM at n_embd=1024, which halves throughput/steps.
reflection: val_bpb 1.052909, notably worse than the 0.998671 baseline (ASPECT_RATIO=96) and even worse than the original 1.014027 baseline. The width axis does not want to keep growing: 64->96 helped but 96->128 hurts substantially, likely because (a) the model is now under-trained in steps at this width within 5 minutes and (b) the forced DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE halving (128->64) doubled grad_accum_steps and roughly halved step count for the same TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE, compounding the fewer-steps problem. This brackets the width sweep: ASPECT_RATIO=96 looks like it's near/at the optimum for this depth (8) and time budget, not a monotonic 'wider is better' relationship. Also flagging a process issue: all 6 round-1 proposals (including my own original one) were identical (stack ASPECT_RATIO=96 + TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE=2^18) -- I abandoned that duplicate at select time and ran this instead to avoid wasting 5 of the group's 30 remaining runs on redundant repeats of the same config.
